summary.en-US: Route browser traffic through the authenticated MidoriVPN proxy.
summary.es: Protege el tráfico del navegador con el proxy autenticado de MidoriVPN.

description.en-US: MidoriVPN is a browser-only VPN proxy client. After the user signs in and explicitly enables protection, the extension routes browser requests through a selected healthy MidoriVPN HTTPS CONNECT gateway. It does not inject ads, execute remote code, or sell user data.
description.es: MidoriVPN es un cliente proxy VPN exclusivo para el navegador. Después de iniciar sesión y activar explícitamente la protección, la extensión dirige las solicitudes del navegador por un gateway HTTPS CONNECT saludable de MidoriVPN. No inyecta anuncios, ejecuta código remoto ni vende datos del usuario.

release_notes.en-US: MidoriVPN 2.0 adds PKCE authentication, encrypted token storage, scoped proxy credentials, browser-specific packages, strict fail-closed routing, and Chromium service-worker recovery.
release_notes.es: MidoriVPN 2.0 incorpora autenticación PKCE, almacenamiento cifrado de tokens, credenciales limitadas al proxy, paquetes específicos por navegador, protección fail-closed y recuperación del service worker de Chromium.

version.approval_notes: The submitted source archive includes release-build-inputs.json with the public endpoints and SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH used for the package. Follow docs/AMO_REVIEWER_BUILD.md to reproduce the Firefox ZIP. The add-on executes no remote code. The manifest declares authenticationInfo, personallyIdentifyingInfo, and browsingActivity because login returns the account name/email and browser destinations transit the selected VPN proxy. OAuth starts only after Sign in; proxy transmission starts only after the user enables the clearly labelled VPN switch. No reviewer credentials are included in source or metadata.
